outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意學生與教授討論擬定專題研究的題目，在教授的個別指導下，進行實驗研究，並將研究結果寫成報告。
The topic of the special projects is discussed and together by the students and advisor. Under the face-to -face instruction of the advisor the student will conduct the research and experiments, and the final report at the end of the semester.
schedule:
每週討論上一週遇到的問題的解決方法、目前的研究進度、下週研究目標的規劃。
The group meeting is held on every week. The intent of the presentation is to speak about the research updates and challenges.
assessment:
會議出席20%、口頭報告40%、期末書面報告40%。
Attendance 20%、Oral presentation 40%、Final report 40%.
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：否

自編教材
Use of self-made materials
